entries.wording: Item delivered
Item available at Pick-up point
Out for delivery - delivery not possible
entries.note: The delivering partner abroad could not deliver: CTT's own scan at the same minute says the delivery was not achieved, and the item then waits at a pick-up point.

entries.wording: Shipment presented without success. Addressee is informed.
entries.note: The notice of the same attempt, an hour later, before the item is available at a pick-up point.

entries.wording: Item arrived at the distribution center - Item can't be assigned to a delivery round - missing information
entries.note: The item stays at the distribution center, off every delivery round, until the information it lacks is found.

entries.wording: Item on it's way to bbox locker
entries.note: bpost sends {{bboxRebrand}} for the locker; its tracker puts the name of the item's bboxRebrandCategory there, from its translations, and so does the parser. A parcel on its way to a locker, before it is available there.

entries.wording: Item on it's way to Parcel Locker
entries.note: The same scan for the parcelLocker category, named from bpost's tracker translations.

entries.wording: Item available at the bbox locker
entries.note: bpost's Item available at the {{bboxRebrand}}, after the scan on its way to the locker: the parcel waits in the locker for its recipient.

entries.wording: Item available at the Parcel Locker
entries.note: The same scan for the parcelLocker category, named from bpost's tracker translations.

entries.wording: The postman's delivery round for your item has started
Your shipment has arrived at the postal operator of the country of destination and will be delivered in the coming days
Your item has been sorted
Item is ready for transport
Shipment ready for transport
Departure to country of destination
Arrival at international depot
Arrival at facilities
entries.note: A parcel posted abroad, at a facility in the sending country before bpost's own scans.

entries.wording: Item has passed a checkpoint
entries.note: A movement scan, with or without a place, as a parcel posted abroad leaves the sending country or Belgium.

entries.wording: Parcel is handled
Landmark Global (bpost) has received the item
Drop off item by the customer
entries.note: The sender's drop-off, before bpost's acceptance of it.

entries.wording: Item accepted after deposit by sender
The return item has been sorted and will be made available for the sender
entries.note: A return label's parcel on its way to the shop that issued the label, which bpost calls the sender.

entries.wording: Confirmation of preparation of the shipment received
Item is announced / Landmark Global (bpost) received the information
Item delivered in mailbox
Item delivered at safeplace
Awaiting presentation to Customs
entries.note: Mail from abroad at the international depot, before customs.

entries.wording: No extra costs
entries.note: Customs cleared mail from abroad without charges.

entries.wording: Departure to distribution network
entries.note: Mail from abroad leaves the international depot for the national network.
